posts.title: Cloudflare: SGLang bug exposed KV cache pages across requests on Workers AI GLM-5.3
posts.summary: A configuration mismatch in the GLM-5.3 deployment on Workers AI triggered an SGLang bug that exposed KV cache pages across requests. Cloudflare explains the root cause and how it remediated with SGLang.

posts.title: NYT cuts Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL migration from 18 to 5 months with AI agents
posts.summary: The New York Times migrated its PLATO subscription revenue engine from Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL. It used an agent-based approach on Bedrock together with AWS DMS to automate schema conversion and multi-language code remediation.

posts.title: Vestiaire Collective: near-zero downtime RDS MariaDB upgrades with Blue/Green
posts.summary: Vestiaire upgraded its RDS for MariaDB fleet across two major versions using RDS Blue/Green Deployments. Switchovers took 94 seconds and then 7 seconds during peak sales season.

posts.title: Breaking the KV cache memory wall with Dynamo and Liqid CXL shared memory
posts.summary: Describes offloading LLM KV cache to CXL-attached shared memory pools, using NVIDIA Dynamo with Liqid composable infrastructure. The aim is to relieve GPU memory limits for inference.
